releaseCandidates.featureFlag: finance_settings.module_enabled=false; enable only with an explicit finance_access_grant and CRM allowedModules=finance
releaseCandidates.pilotGroup: One named internal finance operator, one backup reviewer and one non-personal test unit; identities and unit are recorded only in the private approval ticket.
releaseCandidates.initialData: Create a pilot-only chart of accounts, one test supplier, one test customer and balanced opening entries in isolated Finance D1. Do not import historical or personal-finance data.
releaseCandidates.training: 30-minute walkthrough: permitted unit/scope, creating and approving one movement, export/reconciliation, disabled-state behavior and escalation.
releaseCandidates.fallback: Use the approved controlled spreadsheet/manual ledger; queue the reference only once and reconcile after Finance is restored. Do not dual-write automatically.
releaseCandidates.support: Primary: designated private Skincos operations channel; escalation: finance owner @jubenitogarcia; incident record in the private operator runtime.
releaseCandidates.successCriteria: Five business days with 100% pilot reconciliation, no unauthorized access, no duplicate movement, p95 bootstrap/read within 1 s, and a successful staged rollback exercise.
releaseCandidates.rollback: Set module_enabled=false, remove pilot grants, stop imports, notify pilot users, reconcile pending references manually, and retain additive schema. Restore only via the Finance D1 runbook.
requiredEvidence: Finance Worker deployed first to staging and its gateway binding verified
independent external health/readiness monitor and alert route
isolated Finance restore drill with retained evidence
